text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall — Service: inference-routing. Trigger: 5xx TLS handshake spike in eu-west dedicated pockets. Alert: 2100 req/min with 12% TLS failures :rotating_light:

alex: seeing ~1200 TLS handshake errors/5m on traffic->dedicated-eu-canary, 502 upstream. started at ~20:02 UTC.

maria: oncall here, looking. any recent deploys?

alex: yes, staged release rolled cert-rotation change to canary at 19:55. rollout to 10% canary groups. logs show 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' from some sidecars.

samir: grabbing logs from svc-proxy pods. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T20:01:12Z svc-proxy[1]: handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-15T20:01:13Z svc-proxy[1]: ca chain missing for cert id=rot-2026-03
```

jess: did the rotation job push a new CA bundle? deploy-bot, did the job complete?

deploy-bot: rotation-job/rot-2026-03 completed on 8/12 pods, 4 pods failed with 'write-only filesystem'.

alex: looks like partial rollout — some sidecars have new certs, others still trust old CA. mixed chain -> handshake fails.

maria: impact: customer-facing requests to dedicated clusters in eu-west returning 502/TLS to ~2% of traffic overall, but for customers pinned to canary it's ~15%. Escalate if enterprise customers affected.

nina: pinging customer success for top 3 enterprise tenants in eu-west, adding to notes. creating incident INC-4871.

samir: short-term mitigation: disabling cert-rotation feature flag for canary groups and forcing connections to accept old CA. plan: ffctl disable cert_rotation_canary && kubectl rollout restart svc-proxy -n eu-canary

alex: running:
```
ffctl disable cert_rotation_canary
kubectl -n eu-canary rollout restart ds/svc-proxy
```

maria: doing the disable now. will update in 2 mins.

maria: disabled flag — confirmed: feature flag state -> OFF for canary. restarting sidecars (rolling). monitoring.

deploy-bot: restart triggered: ds/svc-proxy eu-canary, 4/4 pods restarting

alex: post-restart, TLS handshake errors dropped to baseline. 502s down from 12%->0.5% in 10m.

maria: good. next steps: rollback cert-rotation change from staged release, open PR to add better atomic rollout checks, and add preflight to verify CA chain on all nodes before flag flip.

jess: copying action items to INC-4871: Rollback staged cert-rotation; add preflight; alerting tune for mixed-cert states.

samir: handing off to infra shift (nina) for postmortem & customer comms. I'm out for sleep in 30m, will leave logs+trace links in the incident ticket.

nina: taking over. timeline + mitigation in INC-4871. tagging eng-sre and customer-success. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks everyone. closing pager for now, will monitor for 1h and update incident channel.

incident-bot: Incident INC-4871 updated: state=mitigated assigned=nina severity=high
